location_exception_reason: FRP cabins are manufactured commodities with standardised specifications; location of manufacture or seller does not change the product's functional attributes or buyer decision criteria. Buyers evaluate on size, panel thickness, roof style, and electrical fittings—not origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from 'FRP Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged—the product is still an FRP cabin regardless of seller classification.
